method: Manual, non-blind, strict whole-assertion grading against cases.json. Entries are ordered by assertion, then repeated run. Missing caveats fail even when the main recommendation is correct.

cache-cdc.evidence: Baseline recommends BOTH (including as a transition). Updated selects BINLOG_ONLY and correctly covers delivery/retry/readiness, but neither updated answer explicitly explains that both alternatives are deprecated.

insert-if-absent-result.evidence: Baseline never checks isAccepted: run 1 always queries; run 2 inspects saved.getId(). Updated branches on acceptance and performs the conflict lookup with a concurrency policy. Neither condition discusses UPSERT technical self-assignment, required by assertion 3.

external-version.evidence: Baseline invents OptimisticLockMode.VERSION/IGNORE and isModified/nullable-result rejection. Its root-only statements describe the invented mode, not setVersionMode. Updated uses ASSIGNMENT, setUpdateWhere, isAccepted and explicitly states root-only scope.

dissociation.evidence: Both baseline runs put OnDissociate on Warehouse.bins, rejected by Jimmer metadata. Both updated runs put it on Bin.warehouse. All answers correctly distinguish the existing RESTRICT FK from ORM child deletion.

dto-patch.evidence: Baseline uses a bare bins association without a nested shape/ID projection and omits id. Updated iteration 1 includes note?, but a real APT compile rejects redundant ? on an already nullable base property, so its declaration fails assertions 1 and 4. Neither condition explains associated-mode/dissociation requirements for clearing (assertion 3). This failure prompted a documented correction and separate DTO rerun; iteration 1 evidence is retained.

quarkus-current.evidence: Baseline invents GitHub Packages coordinates, mixes artifact families, cannot name CacheReadiness and claims constraint investigation defaults true. Updated uses unified JitPack coordinates, Jandex, exactly one readiness provider with ready/namespace, read-and-fill bypass, tracker-vs-CDC distinction and both actual exception defaults.

inheritance.evidence: Baseline invents DiscriminatorColumn and @Dto hierarchies (run 1 also InheritanceStrategy), and misses explicit type-change API. Updated uses entity inheritance, Discriminator property, nullable subtype columns, #types/#exhaustive and an explicit exact-matched type transition.

insert-from-select.evidence: Baseline invents createInsert(...).columns(...).select(...) and conflict APIs; only run 2 explicitly excludes conflicts from returning. Updated uses the actual typed source and createInsert(target, source) mappings. Both conditions omit dialect/materialization fallback and describe no application materialization without a dialect qualification (assertion 4).
